invariants.rule: Overview/main operational views are derived projections only and never own independent editable operational truth.
Every displayed count/card/timeline/warning/narrative item is traceable to accepted owning-domain identities, relationships, events, snapshots or explicit coverage state.
Customer/period scope applies consistently across all compatible Overview projections and supports explicit unassigned/unresolved populations where governed.
Unknown, partial, stale, excluded and unresolved states remain semantically distinct from zero, healthy, complete, failed or absent.
Unsaved working copies, rejected/deferred proposals and unaccepted import/communication observations never affect authoritative Overview values.
Objective association shown for tickets derives through Tasks; no direct mutable ticket-Objective relation exists for Overview convenience.
SLA monthly membership uses HLD-07 fixed America/Guayaquil cohort authority and is unaffected by Objective display timezone.
Resolved Status Date remains discarded and is never displayed, persisted, inferred or reconstructed from another timestamp.
MSG drafts never contribute to sent communication counts/interaction age; terminal summaries never reconstruct purged bodies.
Inventory mixed/partial states expose constituent counts/positions rather than projecting false aggregate completion.
Any materialized/cache read model is disposable and rebuildable from authoritative accepted state; cache contents never authorize domain mutation.
Operational narrative is deterministic derived presentation and cannot be edited into domain truth or treated as an independent event source.
